# RandomX provenance

RandomX v1.2.1, commit `102f8acf90a7649ada410de5499a7ec62e49e1da`. The source archive used for this snapshot has SHA-256
`91bf75a91614e433194b7cd46248775576d0c82fccc2396d37b3375fc86513e7`.

The C configuration and matching MASM configuration use the SIWORLD Argon2d salt
`SIWORLD/RandomX/ArgonSalt/v1` (28 bytes, excluding the terminating zero).
The CMake build uses the checked-in MASM configuration rather than generating it
with PowerShell. Other upstream RandomX algorithm parameters remain unchanged.
Upstream copyright and license terms are in LICENSE and the original source files.
